title: Relay HTTP API: request and response bodies
description: Every route but GET /config needs an identity: who is asking comes from the relay's identity seam (relay/identity.py). Behind napkin-web (/production/api, features/os-sign-in.clan) that is napkin-web's signed X-Napkin-Identity assertion (docs/contracts/production-tool-identity.md); standalone local development (relay/local.py with no TOKEN_SECRET, the mock relay) names a fixed local person. No identity is a 401. A person whose agency (tenant) is not turned on gets 403 flag_off on every route but GET /health and GET /config. Errors are a non-2xx status with {error} (common error). A 2xx body never carries an error key. Contract 3: a body whose contractVersion is not '3' gets 400 invalid_input 'This build reads contract 3; reload the page.' before anything else is read. Routes: GET /me, POST /uploads, POST /jobs, GET /jobs/{jobId}, DELETE /jobs/{jobId}, POST /jobs/{jobId}/answer, POST /log, POST /clan, GET /projects, GET /clan/{projectId}, GET|PUT /clan/{projectId}/canvas, GET /library/{shelf}, GET|POST /library/{shelf}/{key}[/{ver}], POST /dogfood/consent, POST /dogfood/events, GET /config (served by CloudFront as config.json).

name.description: The person's display name from their Napkin OS account, when it has one.

workspace.description: The agency's workspace: the tenant id. The library and the saved projects are kept in it and shared by everyone in the agency (features/os-sign-in.clan).

quotas.description: Remaining today, per quota class, while the agency's daily quotas are on; null while they are off (the default: contracts/spend-policy.json, features/tenant-limits.clan).

projects.description: How many projects the agency has saved on the relay (GET /projects).

tenant.description: The person's agency as a tenant: id is napkin-web's TenantId::of_agency (UUIDv5 of 'napkin:agency:<agency>').

allow.description: Where the agency's material may go (features/tenant-limits.clan): its tenant item's allow, else contracts/spend-policy.json's. The web hides models whose maker is off and steps with no model left.

dogfood.description: Only while config.json's flags.dogfood is on (features/production-tool-dogfood.clan): whether this person has acknowledged the beta notice.

Me.description: GET /me: who the identity seam says is asking, their tenant and its workspace, today's remaining quotas (null while off), its allowlist and the agency's saved projects. 401 when there is no identity; 403 flag_off when the agency is not turned on.

UploadRequest.description: Ask for a place to put an artifact. The browser hashes first; if the relay already has the hash, no upload is needed.

putUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT, 15 min. Absent when exists is true.

putHeaders.description: Headers the PUT must carry besides Content-Type, as given: x-amz-checksum-sha256 binds the upload to its hash, so S3 refuses other bytes (features/tenant-limits.clan). With putUrl only.

url.description: The CloudFront path providers read. HTTPS, answers HEAD with Content-Type and Content-Length, no redirects (Runway's rules).

JobRequest.description: POST /jobs. The client makes jobId; sending the same jobId again returns the existing job and never pays twice. The job runs on the first provider of its op's routing (or the pick); Runway, the floor, makes it again once on its default model for the op when that provider fails for a provider or account reason before or after submit (Job.fallbackFrom and fallbackReason say so; features/runway-fallback.clan). Moderated or invalid input never falls back. frame_edit (Change this frame) needs the current frame (input.image), the shot with its camera and the words, may carry a region or mask, and takes no anchorFrame, previousFrame or modelChoice: Dex reads the words against the frame and the relay runs the op it resolves (features/frame-change-edit.clan). A Redo is a new frame_edit job with parentIds [the earlier job]. clip_patch (Fix this moment) needs the parent take (input.video), the note's window and atS in take time and the note's words; it regenerates only the window and splices it back (features/clip-moment-edit.clan).

parentIds.description: Jobs whose outputs this one builds on (provenance edges).

modelChoice.description: The model the person picked when regenerating (features/model-choice.clan): an op's model or one of its alternates on a provider routed for the op (Runway's models are always pickable). Absent: the routing's default. The job runs on that provider and model; when it fails for a provider or account reason, it runs once on Runway's default model for the op (Job.fallbackFrom says so).

quality.description: clip and clip_edit (features/clip-quality.clan): the size to make, from the video's default or the person's pick. Absent: standard. The model's sheet (ops[op].quality) says what size each level is; a level the model lacks runs at its nearest, and a family (Kling O3) runs the member that makes it. Job.quality says what ran. Added 2026-10-15 (additive).

promoteFrom.description: clip and clip_edit: Remake as Final (features/clip-quality.clan). The id of a finished job of this project whose take is remade at `quality`: the relay runs that job's own input on the model it ran on (the family member for the level), reusing Dex's directed request, so the words, pictures and length are the draft's; this request's input and modelChoice are ignored. A Seedance 2.5 draft under 7 days old is made final by Runway itself (draftTaskId). Added 2026-10-15 (additive).

projectId.description: The document's project.id: jobs are the project's, whoever started them.

nonce.description: The client's nonce: an intentional 'another take' carries a new one, so it is never deduped with the running job (ui-behaviour 4.3).

purpose.description: What the job is for, in the app's words (the document's jobs[id].purpose).

node.description: The node the job runs for: dedupe is keyed by (node, op, input hashes) while it runs.

TypeLayer.description: A type layer laid out for one size (features/campaign-formats.clan; web campaign/layout.ts, the one layout function): the relay (stills) or stitch (video) draws it over the picture. Words and the logo are never sent to a model.

box.description: Where it sits, in 0-1 coordinates of the size.

sizeFrac.description: The type's cap height as a share of the size's height (the relay shrinks it to fit the box).

plate.description: A colour band behind the words (supers on a busy picture).

JobInput.description: What the user asked for, in our terms. The director turns it into a provider job. Which fields apply depends on op; the relay rejects missing ones with invalid_input.

text.description: The user's words: the Generate instruction (with the text of any selected notes), the text box under a frame or clip, the region note, the feel change, the Change this frame words.

remove.description: region_edit only: the Image editor's Remove (features/image-editor-masks-layers.clan, 2026-10-16). What the mask covers is taken out and the background continues over it. It carries no words: the relay writes the removal itself (service.REMOVE_WORDS), and the director reads them as words that remove. Needs image, mask and region; never with text.

refs.description: Every image input, in the order chosen, each with its role: the director writes refRoleTable's prompt_line for it. The relay gives each a wire tag (relay/names.py) before the director sees the job.

id.description: The ref id for a named image, else the canvas node id.

name.description: key_variant for a named image; absent for an unnamed node (the relay numbers those in_1, in_2…).

kind.description: drawing: the participant's own strokes, a rough guide for shape and pose, not a finished look.

label.description: The ref's free label ('Maya's beach outfit').

optional.description: Offered, not asked for (owner 2026-10-15, features/canvas-nodes.clan): in the node's scope but not named by the shot's words or linked into the shot. The director may send it only as an addition that gives a definite advantage, listed in its output's `added` with why; the relay strips one sent without a reason. Absent: required, the job sends it (a frame or a clip may not leave it out or swap it for another picture).

view.description: view: which view to make from image (the source).

script.description: shot_list: the script text Dex plans from (the scenes' unplanned text, or the shots' text when re-planning). frame: the script for the setting, cut to its first 600 characters by the web.

shot.description: frame, clip, frame_edit, clip_patch: the shot being made.

previousFrame.description: frame: the previous selected frame, for continuity.

anchorFrame.description: frame: the first storyboard frame, the setting/light/style anchor for every later frame

image.description: region_edit, frame_edit: the image being edited (frame_edit: the shot's current frame). A region_edit with no region and no mask changes the whole image, keeping its composition (ideogram_4_5 preciseEdit; features/image-editor.clan). view: the source image. clip: the storyboard frame. upscale: the image to upscale. cutout: the image whose background Rhea removes (the relay's own segmenter, no provider).

mask.description: region_edit, frame_edit, clip_edit: a PNG mask (white = change, our convention); the adapter converts it per provider. Absent when the user drew only a box. A frame_edit Dex reads as a camera change redraws the whole frame and does not use it.

video.description: clip_edit: the clip being changed. clip_patch: the parent take being patched (features/clip-moment-edit.clan). stitch: not used (see clips).

atS.description: clip_edit: the paused time of a region comment. clip_patch: the note's moment, in seconds of TAKE time (clan-store noteToTakeWindow), inside window.

feel.description: clip_edit without a region: change the whole clip.

clips.description: stitch: the picked takes in cut order. An end-card shot's clip carries endCard: the relay leaves it out, because stitch draws the end card itself (its payload is unchanged).

inS.description: Where the clip starts in its take (the edl item's in_s). Absent: 0.

outS.description: The take's last usable second (the edl item's out_s): no frame after it is shown, and a clip that ends before its trimS is held on its last frame.

transition.description: The join into this clip from the one before (features/connected-video.clan). Absent: a cut. A dissolve or dip overlaps the clips by s seconds, taken from the outgoing clip's out-handle, so the ad keeps its length. Ignored on the first clip.

answer.description: Change (ui-behaviour 3.17): the new answer to the question the parent job (parentIds [jobId]) asked, sent as a follow-up job.

shots.description: shot_list when re-planning: the storyboard's shots as they are, so planning is a merge keyed by shot id.

aspect.description: The exact shape wanted, when it is not one of the four ratios (a format's size).

context.description: What the node's links bring besides pictures: notes, documents and the Brand board's rules. Dex writes brand rules into the prompt and uses documents as background only.

window.description: clip_patch: the note's window in whole seconds of TAKE time (clan-store noteToTakeWindow maps a shot-time note onto the take): only these seconds are regenerated, the rest of the take is kept. At least 2 s wide.

still.description: clip_patch: the edited still at atS (the review's still, from Edit still). Absent: no keyframe is sent at the default context 0, so an unedited frame never anchors the edit.

scale.description: upscale: how many times each side grows (the Image editor's 2x or 4x; Export at full size's 4x, or 8x for the largest print sizes). Absent: 2. Added 2026-10-15 (additive, features/image-editor.clan); 8 added 2026-10-16 (features/campaign-formats.clan).

layers.description: upscale for delivery (Export at full size; features/campaign-formats.clan, with input.delivery): the size's type layers, drawn by the relay at the delivery size over the upscaled plate. Never sent to the model. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

resize.description: resize (Make all sizes; features/campaign-formats.clan): one size of a format set, made from the master's clean plate (input.image: the picture with no type and no logo). method crop and layout are free: the relay crops (subject-aware: the crop keeps every protected box, as much of the safe area as the shape allows), scales to the preview and draws the type layers itself; no provider, no spend, not counted in a quota. extend and regenerate run on the op's models (phase 4): extend an Ideogram 4.5 mask on the relay's padded canvas of the master, regenerate Gemini 3 Pro with the master as @master at the nearest ratio (and, when input.refs carries a named picture's other views, up to 4 of them as tagged references so a character stays itself; extend and crop ignore input.refs; added 2026-10-16, features/resize-selection.clan); both cropped to the exact shape. reedit, reframe and nearest answer capability_missing. Never carries words for a model: layers are drawn by the relay.

masterSize.description: The pixels protect and crop are in (format_set.master w and h); the relay scales them to the picture it reads.

crop.description: The crop to use (the size's own, or the person's). Absent: the relay works it out from protect and the safe area.

previewMaxPx.description: The preview's longest side; the result is the delivery shape at most this long (never larger than the delivery). Absent: 2048.

background.description: layout: the brand colour the picture sits on.

source.description: regenerate: what input.image is. sketch (a scamp: a Drawing or a sketch area's picture; features/resize-selection.clan) is drawn as a finished picture at the shape, the sketch as its layout. Absent: picture. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

panel.description: layout: where the picture sits on the colour field, in 0-1 coordinates of the size; crop is then the part of the master at the panel's shape. Absent: the whole size. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

cutdown.description: cutdown (features/campaign-formats.clan, phases 5 and 6): a length or a shape of the film as windows of the same takes, rendered by stitch. A re-edit spends nothing on a provider; a reframe crops each clip and outpaints only the clips marked outpaint (Aleph 2).

crop.description: In takeSize pixels; absent: the whole frame.

outpaint.description: The crop would cut a protected box: Aleph 2 makes the new edges of this clip.

fadeOutS.description: The master mix is trimmed with this fade until audio-mix rebuilds it to length.

Job.description: Response of POST /jobs and GET /jobs/{jobId}, and the DynamoDB ledger item (pk = jobId). Poll GET no faster than nextPollS.

queuePosition.description: Our fair-share queue position, or the provider's when it reports one.

quality.description: clip and clip_edit (features/clip-quality.clan): the level the job ran at and the size it asked the model for ("720p", "2K"). Absent where the model keeps the clip's own size. Added 2026-10-15 (additive).

fallbackFrom.description: Where the job was meant to run (the person's pick, or the first provider of its chain) when it ran on another provider instead: the next one in its chain, or Runway, the floor, after a failure before or after submit.

fallbackReason.description: Why the job left the provider in fallbackFrom, in words a person can read ('Runway could not make it: it is busy.'). When that provider may already have the job (it gave no answer in time), it says it may still charge.

requestId.description: The provider's task or request id, saved before the relay answers.

kind.description: mock outputs are labelled everywhere and can never count as final.

startedBy.description: Who started the job: its cost is on their budget, whoever answers its question.

crew.description: Who works it: dex for planning, wren (Fin) for frames and clips, edie for the ad, …

question.description: needs_input: what the agent asked. Its id is the document's ask key.

answeredBy.description: Who answered the question: the first answer wins.

writes.description: write only: Skye's drafts, each landing as a suggestion on its target (one job may draft several).

resize.description: resize only: how the size was made. crop: the part of the master used, in masterSize pixels (the whole master for extend and regenerate). previewPx: the result's size. plate: the picture before type.

layers.description: How many type layers the relay drew.

plate.description: The size's picture before its type layers, at the preview size: Edit type draws on it again for free, and Export at full size upscales it. Added 2026-10-16 (additive).

patch.description: clip_patch only (features/clip-moment-edit.clan): what was patched and how. send: range (the whole take went, with the window as the keyframe's range; Aleph 2 edits and bills only the range) or cut (only the window, plus contextS, was cut out and sent) or frames (a first/last-frame model made the window from the frames at its ends). window: the note's window in take time. cut: the take seconds sent to the model. range: the keyframe's whole-second range in the seconds sent, when one was sent. keyframe: none (the whole cut is the edit), still (the frame at atS) or edited (the review's edited still). model: what made the window. exact: every parent GOP away from the window was copied untouched (false: the whole take was re-encoded once). seams: Jude's check of both seams (relative SSIM; ok when at or above clipPatch.seamMin). rawOutput: the model's own output, kept when the splice failed. The landed take always keeps the take's own sound (Aleph keeps its input audio; a cut send's splice copies it), so a visual change that needs new sound is the sound mix's to make.

handoff.description: clip_patch only: the person chose to remake the whole clip when asked, so this job was cancelled (free, the quota back) and the client sends the op named here through the send tray.

LogEntry.description: POST /log: client errors and the Report button.

ClanMirror.description: POST /clan (added 2026-10-06, additive): the participant's current .clan. Not JSON: the body is the .clan bytes (a ZIP, at most 5 MiB). Headers: Authorization Bearer token, Content-Type application/vnd.clan+zip, X-Clan-Reason interval|accept|manual, and optionally X-Project-Id (a project id, the common id pattern; added 2026-10-09, features/project-home.clan). With X-Project-Id the save is one of the person's projects (features/personal-workspaces.clan, 2026-10-09): optional X-Project-Name (the name Home shows, percent-encoded UTF-8, at most 80 characters) and optional If-Match (the project's ETag this save started from). With If-Match, 409 conflict when someone saved the project since (nothing is overwritten); without it the save is taken as before. It answers 200 ClanSaved, stored at s3 clan/<participantId>/<projectId>/<UTC time>-<etag8>-<reason>.clan (every save, kept) and clan/<participantId>/<projectId>/latest.clan, listed in clan/<participantId>/projects.json. Without X-Project-Id it answers 204, stored at clan/<participantId>/latest.clan and clan/<participantId>/<UTC time>-<reason>.clan. 401 without a valid token; 400 when the body is not a ZIP or X-Project-Id is not an id; 413 above 5 MiB. This object documents the headers only.

LibraryRef.description: One variant of a published key.

LibraryPublish.description: POST /library/{shelf}/{key}: publish the next version. Every asset must already be uploaded. baseVer is the version the document holds (0 for a new key); a newer one on the server is 409 conflict ('Maya published v5 a moment ago').

kind.description: key: a reference key and its variants (refs). brand_kit: the Brand board's logo, palette, fonts and rules (payload). format_pack: a client's own format pack (payload, format-packs.schema.json#/$defs/pack).

payload.description: brand_kit and format_pack: the kit or pack itself.

LibraryEntry.description: GET /library/{shelf}/{key}[/{ver}], and the answer to a publish: one immutable version. Stored at tenants/{tenantId}/library/{shelf}/{key}/{ver}.json.

shelf.description: A client's shelf (its client id), or 'agency' for what no client owns.

kind.description: key: a reference key and its variants (refs). brand_kit: the Brand board's logo, palette, fonts and rules (payload). format_pack: a client's own format pack (payload, format-packs.schema.json#/$defs/pack).

LibraryIndex.description: GET /library/{shelf}: the shelf's items, latest version each. Stored at tenants/{tenantId}/library/{shelf}/index.json, written with If-Match on its ETag.

cover.description: The front variant if there is one, else the first.

kind.description: key: a reference key and its variants (refs). brand_kit: the Brand board's logo, palette, fonts and rules (payload). format_pack: a client's own format pack (payload, format-packs.schema.json#/$defs/pack).

shelf.description: A client's shelf (its client id), or 'agency' for what no client owns.

SavedProject.description: One saved project of the person's (GET /projects, ClanSaved). Added 2026-10-09 (features/personal-workspaces.clan).

name.description: X-Project-Name of the newest save that sent one; absent when none did.

etag.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the saved .clan bytes: send it as If-Match on the next save.

ProjectList.description: GET /projects: the caller's saved projects (any browser), newest save first. Only the caller's own.

ClanSaved.description: POST /clan with X-Project-Id: the save the relay kept. Its etag goes in If-Match on the next save.

ProjectOpen.description: GET /clan/{projectId}: the newest saved .clan of the caller's project. Not JSON: the body is the .clan bytes (application/vnd.clan+zip), with headers ETag (the quoted SavedProject.etag) and X-Saved-At. 404 when the caller has no such project; 413 when it is over 4.3 MB (a Lambda answer is at most 6 MB base64-encoded: export it instead). This object documents the headers only.

ProjectCanvas.description: PUT /clan/{projectId}/canvas (body, 204) and GET /clan/{projectId}/canvas (answer): the canvas that goes with the project's saved .clan, so it opens in another browser as it was. The Excalidraw elements only; pictures are rebuilt from the project's assets by hash (customdata.schema.json). At most 4 MB. 404 when the project is not saved, or (GET) has no canvas. Added 2026-10-09 (features/personal-workspaces.clan).

savedAt.description: Set by the relay; ignored on PUT.

DogfoodShellEvent.description: One thing the web app saw a participant do (features/production-tool-dogfood.clan). Never a hover, pointer move, scroll, wheel, timeupdate or keystroke; a run of identical events is sent as its first plus one kind 'repeat' {of, count, first, last}.

DogfoodBatch.description: POST /dogfood/events: a batch of the web app's events (at most 500, 256 KiB). 404 when flags.dogfood is off, 403 before POST /dogfood/consent.

WriteInput.description: write (Skye, features/script-editor.clan): what to draft or rewrite, and the words around it. base_hash comes back on each write, so a draft lands right after a reload.

explicit.description: A person pressed it on a target Skye was asked to leave alone (hands_off).

Write.description: One of Skye's drafts: the target's new lines, written against base_hash. Lands as a suggestion; nothing changes until Keep.

JobShot.description: A shot as a job sends it: the document's shot with its flat text, its refs as names (the relay tags them) and its beats.

JobAnswer.description: POST /jobs/{jobId}/answer: a person's answer to the job's question. The job resumes on the same jobId and its starter's budget; any member of the job's tenant may answer. A second answer is 409 AnswerConflict with the winner.

AnswerConflict.description: 409 from POST /jobs/{jobId}/answer: someone answered first. The card shows their answer; the person's own is not applied.
